description: This file contains functions and type definitions for handling Matrix protocol targets, including parsing, normalization, and identification of user and room IDs.

methods.name: stripKnownPrefixes
methods.description: Removes known prefixes from a raw string, trimming whitespace and matching against provided prefixes.

methods.name: resolveMatrixTargetIdentity
methods.description: Resolves a raw string into a MatrixTarget object, identifying whether it is a user or room target.

methods.name: isMatrixQualifiedUserId
methods.description: Checks if a string is a qualified Matrix user ID starting with '@' and containing ':'.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixResolvableTarget
methods.description: Removes known prefixes to produce a normalized target string.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixMessagingTarget
methods.description: Removes known prefixes to produce a normalized messaging target string or undefined.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixDirectoryUserId
methods.description: Normalizes a user ID for directory purposes, returning undefined if input is invalid or a wildcard.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixDirectoryGroupId
methods.description: Normalizes a group ID for directory purposes, handling room, channel, and other IDs.

methods.name: resolveMatrixDirectUserId
methods.description: Resolves a direct message user ID based on parameters, ensuring chatType is 'direct' and IDs are qualified.
